attempts.sql: SELECT 'auto_ontology/server/' || regexp_extract(file_id, '^auto_ontology/server/([^/]+)/', 1) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE regexp_matches(file_id, '^auto_ontology/server/[^/]+/.+[.]py$') GROUP BY 'auto_ontology/server/' || regexp_extract(file_id, '^auto_ontology/server/([^/]+)/', 1) HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY SUM(line_count) DESC

request:
Within auto_ontology/server/, which immediate subfolders contain more than 1,000 lines of Python in total? Count every .py file anywhere inside the subfolder, including its test files and __init__.py; files directly in auto_ontology/server/ itself belong to no subfolder. Return the subfolder's repository-relative path (e.g. auto_ontology/server/chat) and its total line count.

Requested output columns: folder_path (string), total_lines (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This sums the Python line counts of every .py file located anywhere beneath each immediate subfolder of auto_ontology/server/, using the repository-relative file paths and per-file line counts from the files table. Files sitting directly in auto_ontology/server/ itself are excluded, and test files and __init__.py files are counted like any other module. Only subfolders whose combined Python lines exceed 1,000 are returned, showing the full repository-relative subfolder path and its total lines, ordered from largest to smallest total.
sql: SELECT 'auto_ontology/server/' || regexp_extract(file_id, '^auto_ontology/server/([^/]+)/', 1) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE regexp_matches(file_id, '^auto_ontology/server/[^/]+/.+[.]py$') GROUP BY 'auto_ontology/server/' || regexp_extract(file_id, '^auto_ontology/server/([^/]+)/', 1) HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY SUM(line_count) DESC
